name: Challani Capital Limited
about: Challani Capital Limited provides financing services in India. The company offers loan against property; vehicle loans, including heavy duty, medium duty, intermediate duty, light duty, pick up, and mini trucks; gold loans; and education loans. The company was formerly known as Indo Asian Finance Limited and changed its name to Challani Capital Limited in August 2023. Challani Capital Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Chennai, India.
